messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout of sdk@1.9.0 to 5% of streaming traffic in us-west-2. config: streaming-handshake=v2 enabled. will monitor for 30m. :rocket:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: streaming-handshake errors spike in canary clusters (us-west-2-canary-*, 5xx handshake). Error rate ~18% over baseline for last 3m. Paging on-call.
jordan: on it — joining. can you drop logs or sample connection traces?
maria: flagged — this was the change that bumps the wire handshake to v2 and expects client frames with `0x02` preface. wondering if older SDKs are still hitting the canary.
kevin: @maria release pipeline shows canary subset included both baked clients + new runtime. I thought we gated it. investigating rollout targets.
emily: seeing a bunch of `handshake timeout` followed by `invalid frame preface` in canary logs. pasted one sample below:
```
2026-06-12T02:14:03Z ERROR rpc/stream.go:217 handshake failed: unexpected preface 0x01, expected 0x02
2026-06-12T02:14:03Z WARN rpc/conn.go:98 client-version: 1.8.4
```
ashwin: that log indicates older SDKs (1.8.x) are still hitting canary. we should stop the canary immediately — kill the FF.
kevin: toggling feature flag `sdk_streaming_v2` -> false for canary ring now (using feature-manager). command: `./ffctl set sdk_streaming_v2 false --env prod --ring canary`
kevin: done. FF false. confirming.
oncall-bot: FF toggle event detected: sdk_streaming_v2=false (by kevin) — mitigations: traffic will fall back to v1 in ~15s.
jordan: watching metrics — error rate dropping. still see residual handshake failures as existing connections drain.
maria: can we roll back the canary deployment too? I want to avoid mixed runtime behavior while we sort SDK compatibility matrix.
kevin: initiating rollback of release job canary set to previous spec. `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/sdk-ingress --to-revision=42`
kevin: rollback initiated.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: rollback rollout job completed for `sdk-ingress` in us-west-2-canary.
emily: errors down to ~1.2% now, basically baseline. good.
support-bot: PSA: support queue shows 18 incoming tickets referencing streaming disconnects; 4 are high-touch customers (Acme, LumenAI, Vaultly, and BrightMap). I've DM'd account owners.
maria: thanks. I want a quick customer-impact assessment: which endpoints affected, window, and are there any data loss concerns?
support-bot: affected endpoint: `/v1/stream` and websocket fallback. window: 02:12–02:22 UTC (est). Most requests were retried by clients; no persistent state loss seen. flags: some long-lived streams got disconnected and need client reconnection.
jordan: patching runbook: add explicit check for client-version header on handshake; if missing, fallback to v1 automatically to avoid hard failures.
maria: can we add runtime guard that accepts preface 0x01 and translates to 0x02 for a short-migration window? Implement as compatibility shim in the gateway.
nashwin: agree — implement shim + metrics, then re-run canary against only clients advertising 1.9.x.
kevin: re-deploy plan: 1) add shim to gateway binary, 2) promote canary after verifying compatibility headers 3) only then flip FF. estimate ~2 hours for dev+canary test.
emily: creating a follow-up bug + PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/4832 (WIP)
maria: assign to me and ashwin for the compatibility shim. I will coordinate with SRE for gradual canary.
jordan: handoff: I'm on-call for next 1h and will monitor dashboard; leave a note if there's re-escalation.
kevin: status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2026-06-12-streaming-handshake — we've marked "degraded" and noted rollback and mitigations.
support-bot: Created incident in Zendesk for impacted customers and sent templated note to top 4 accounts.
maria: retrospective action items: - improve rollout targeting to ensure only new clients hit handshake v2 - add client-version gating to canary - compatibility shim - add e2e test that exercises mixed-version connections
ashwin: adding a temporary metric alert : `streaming.handshake.5xx` threshold lowered to detect earlier.
emily: PR created, will add reviewers.
kevin: final: canary fully rolled back, FF killed, metric normalized. will schedule a controlled re-rollout once shim + gated canary ready. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
(jordan, oncall-bot, deploy-bot): reaction :thumbsup:
